title: SegFormer
paper_title: SegFormer: Simple and Efficient Design for Semantic Segmentation with Transformers
core_mech: 层级 MiT 编码器结合 overlap patch、K/V 缩减 attention 与含 depthwise Conv 的 Mix-FFN，再接全 MLP 轻量 decoder。
core_mech_en: Hierarchical Mix Transformer (MiT) encoder with overlapping patches, sequence-reduced attention, and 3×3 depthwise Mix-FFN paired with an all-MLP decoder.
input_desc: 任意常见分辨率的 2D 图像
output_desc: 全分辨率语义分割概率图
